speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I see you are suffering from severe fatigue and itching along with abnormal liver tests. To help me pinpoint the cause, have you noticed any jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes) or dark urine recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your history of ulcerative colitis and risky sexual contact, are you currently taking any immunosuppressant medications like azathioprine or methotrexate? Also, have you noticed any skin rashes or changes in the color of your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC)

REQUEST TEST: Antimitochondrial Antibody (AMA), Alkaline Phosphatase levels, and Liver Biopsy.

REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound of the abdomen to rule out biliary obstruction.
